bead.title: Document and gate the hot projection query substrate
bead.description:
PROBLEM
After implementation, the public docs and final gates must prove the hot projection substrate is documented, discoverable, and does not regress the workspace.

PROPOSED FIX
Update public/contract docs with query capability names, index declaration examples, consistency/watermark semantics, cursor invalidation behavior, aggregate limits, bounded mutation semantics, side-record query language, backend capability matrix, and non-goals. Run final fmt, clippy, public query tests, and full workspace tests.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- docs/ contract and test-plan docs.
- crates/pqueue/tests/hot_projection_queries.rs only for final assertions or names.

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- New feature implementation beyond doc/test fixes needed to close the epic.
- Release tagging.

SIDE-RECORD DOC NOTE
Document `side_record_query` as a defined-but-deferred capability: semantics live in the contract, all backends advertise it unavailable in this epic, and implementation is a follow-up epic.
bead.acceptance:
1. `rg -n 'hot projection|range scan|hourly_distribution_by_status|recycling_preview_by_hour|cursor pagination|bounded mutation|side-record query' docs crates` finds the governing contract and test references.
2. `cargo test -p pqueue --test hot_projection_queries -- --nocapture` passes.
3. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
4. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes.
5. `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features` passes.
